name: Advocate Ruins
title: Advocate Ruins
summary: The secret training grounds of Strathelar's Order of Advocates. The dungeon is gone, but the ruins and the Life Stone remain (acpedia). In the kit, Empyrean ruins fill a grassy hollow at z 4: a moss-green two-storey hall with four stone pillars and ancient columns, the Broken Seal of the Elder Spirits, a fabric-covered platform and a brick foundation. The hollow is ringed by a plateau (z 12-14) that carries a three-storey brick hall, the Life Stone, candle sentinels, pyramid stones and a bunker.

site.name: Advocate Ruins
site.notes: The gazetteer entry advocate-ruins is only a map @tele and the nearest exact teleport (life-stone-at-28-6s-78-3e) lands on the Life Stone itself; derived @teleloc on the open slope 29 m south-west of it instead (ground z 7.5, nearest tree 12.6 m). Landblocks west of x 43008 (0xDF5A-0xDF5C) are missing from the kit: every camera stays east of x 43120.

shots.standingOrder: Arc slowly clockwise round the Advocate ruins 66 m out and 38 m up with the low sun behind the lens, holding the moss-green hall, its columns and the Life Stone on the rim in frame; 10 m over every crown.
shots.notes: Slow 29 degree clockwise arc, 66 m out and 38 m above the hollow, from south-west to west of the Advocates' ruin. The moss-green pillared hall, the Broken Seal, the three-storey brick hall and the Life Stone on the rim turn in the golden light (0.74) coming from behind the lens. The orbit stays 34 m above the plateau, and every camera stays east of x 43160, well inside the kit. shots.standingOrder: Push slowly in from beside the three-storey hall on the Advocates' Life Stone on the ruin's eastern rim, the low western sun raking across it and the ruin hollow beyond; nothing between lens and stone.
